roofline_model.conclusion: All measured points have AI >> ridge_point. All are compute-bound, not memory-bound.

analysis: All shapes have AI > 100 FLOP/byte. The memory bandwidth ridge point (compute_peak/memory_bw) is ~141 FLOP/byte at 2000 GOPS / 14 GB/s. All M scaling points (AI=100-323) and K sweep points (AI=323-614) are above the ridge point. The kernel is compute-bound. The 53 GOPS at K=1024 is the single-AIE-core scalar compute ceiling.
